tool_args.rationale: The previous execution failed because predict referenced an undefined _FIT_ROWS. This version fits the four parameters numerically from train_rows, stores them for predict, and uses the recalled transformed cooperative Hill inhibition law with tau_scale 2.5. The paid probe supplied the additional branch and gradient coverage needed; no further probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The targeted open-branch probe added two observations and broadened input/gradient coverage; these seven rows are sufficient to fit the recalled four-parameter law.
It omits the strong observed sink-gradient dependence and does not match the recalled mechanism signature.
At constant horizon it predicts no dependence on u_now or s_grad, contrary to the measurements.
It is explicitly nuisance information and does not resolve parameter identifiability.
